description: Regression scenarios for planning anchors, non-interactive defaults, and re-plan mode boundaries.

evals.name: normal-plan-with-explicit-output
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan --output docs/ywc-plans/billing-dashboard.md to plan a billing dashboard with exportable invoices.
expected_behavior: Clarifies or records the required planning anchors before writing the plan.
Writes or targets the explicit output path.
Produces a spec-ready plan suitable for downstream validation and task generation.
anti_behavior: Defaulting to ./plan.md despite --output.
Skipping out-of-scope and done-when anchors.
Starting implementation tasks instead of producing the plan.

evals.name: non-interactive-defaults
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan --non-interactive for a small CLI helper idea with no explicit Out of Scope.
expected_behavior: Does not pause for clarification prompts.
Uses the documented defaults for missing anchors.
Clearly marks defaulted anchors so later validation can review them.
anti_behavior: Blocking on interactive questions.
Inventing highly specific exclusions not supplied by the user.
Omitting the defaulted anchor fields.

evals.name: anti-replan-missing-failure-context
expected_behavior: Stops before modifying the spec.
Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT because --update-spec requires --failure-context.
Does not rewrite the existing spec from scratch.
anti_behavior: Appending vague amendments without the review findings.
Treating update-spec as normal plan generation.
Deleting or replacing validated spec sections.

evals.name: route-multi-session-discovery-to-wayfinder
evals.prompt: We know the destination, but the billing migration strategy still needs several unresolved decisions tracked across multiple sessions. Use ywc-plan to pick the next step.
expected_behavior: Routes to ywc-wayfinder instead of drafting a concrete plan immediately.
Mentions the local discovery map and one active ticket rule before planning resumes.
anti_behavior: Pretending the discovery state is already plan-ready.
Treating ywc-wayfinder as ordinary brainstorming.

evals.name: agentic-result-profile-contract
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan --non-interactive --artifact-profile agentic to plan a small, self-contained CLI change.
expected_behavior: Creates an existing regular Markdown artifact under docs/ywc-plans/ named docs/ywc-plans/YYYYMMDD-small_<slug>.md.
Returns exactly one success Result block with only Status, Scale, and Artifact fields, where Scale is Small.
Validates the labelled Artifact as repository-relative and inside docs/ywc-plans/ before any downstream handoff.
anti_behavior: Accepting --artifact-profile agentic together with --output.
Recovering an artifact from plan.md, prose, a basename, or raw response text.
Treating a missing, duplicate, out-of-root, escaping, non-Markdown, or non-regular Artifact as usable.
Writing raw response, transcript, or raw tool output into diagnostics.

evals.name: agentic-result-rejection-is-bounded
evals.prompt: Parse a ywc-plan response containing two Result blocks, a conflicting Scale, and an out-of-root Artifact.
expected_behavior: Returns BLOCKED with only producer name, failed field, candidate count, path digest, and a bounded reason.
Makes zero downstream calls and does not select a fallback or guessed artifact.
anti_behavior: Choosing the first or last Result block.
Scanning unlabelled prose or --output to recover an artifact path.

evals.name: result-parser-exact-matrix
evals.prompt: Evaluate ywc-plan's agentic Result parser with one complete block, duplicate or missing Scale/Artifact fields, unlabelled prose, an outside-root path, and a non-Markdown artifact.

input.accepted: ## Result with Status: DONE, Scale: Small|Medium|Large, and one docs/ywc-plans/*.md Artifact

evals.expected_status: DONE for the accepted fixture; BLOCKED for every rejected fixture
evals.expected_handoff: accepted only for the exact complete in-root Markdown Result; rejected otherwise
evals.expected_output: Reports bounded parser failure details without storing response text or selecting a fallback path.

evals.name: medium-spec-no-quality-contract
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan to draft a Medium spec for an internal reporting change with no quality-gate request.
expected_behavior: Includes the exact Quality Gate Contract sentinel: N/A — no quality gate contract.
Preserves the existing planning, validation, and handoff behavior without selecting a quality-gate worker.
anti_behavior: Emitting an empty or placeholder quality-gate packet.
Inventing thresholds, command identities, digests, or executable commands.

evals.name: medium-spec-valid-quality-contract
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan to draft a Large spec with an explicitly requested advisory Quality Gate Contract.
expected_behavior: Declares the contract state, exact production and test/fixture ownership paths and symbols, caller-approved command IDs and digests, sanitized evidence paths, complexity threshold, mutation target, attempt cap, and residual-survivor handling.
Keeps the declaration bounded metadata and cites the shared quality-gates reference; it contains no raw command text.
anti_behavior: Treating an incomplete declaration as an executable contract.
Broadening module boundaries or allowing downstream consumers to infer missing fields.

evals.name: quality-contract-missing-field-needs-context
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan for a Medium spec whose requested advisory Quality Gate Contract has ownership paths but no approved command digests or evidence destinations.
expected_behavior: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT for the incomplete declaration.
Does not invent command identities, digests, thresholds, paths, or a passing result.
anti_behavior: Filling missing fields with defaults or placeholders.
Handing off an incomplete packet as valid.

evals.name: quality-contract-no-fabricated-command
evals.prompt: Use ywc-plan to draft a Medium spec with an opt-in Quality Gate Contract when the user has not supplied any approved command identity or digest.
expected_behavior: Requests the missing approved command metadata or returns NEEDS_CONTEXT.
Uses only immutable command IDs and digests when supplied; never writes raw executable command text into the declaration.
anti_behavior: Guessing npm, pytest, cargo, or other project commands.
Treating a tool name or prose instruction as an approved command identity.
